Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement pipeline behavior
B. Review / autofix / conflict-resolution behavior
C. Orchestrator / validate / workflow-analysis behavior
D. Docs / templates / developer-facing guidance only
E. Other — name the exact workflow, script, or file path (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What specific problem are you trying to solve?
Choices:
A. Something is broken or incorrect now — describe the wrong behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Something is flaky or unreliable — describe where it happens (RECOMMENDED)
C. A capability is missing — describe the needed behavior
D. The current behavior is too slow / costly / noisy — describe the overhead
E. Other — describe the problem in 1–2 sentences
Q3. What should count as “done” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run / issue / PR is fixed — provide the link or identifier (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific before/after behavior changes — describe both states (RECOMMENDED)
C. A specific file or function is updated — name the path/symbol and expected result
D. Other — provide concrete acceptance criteria
